reason: A dsh bridge plugin and Chrome MV3 extension that lets an agent inspect and operate a user-controlled browser tab through structured text and browser actions.

summaries.zh: 将 dsh 连接到 Chrome 侧边栏，使智能体能够读取页面结构化文本并执行点击、填表、滚动和导航等浏览器操作。
summaries.en: Connects dsh to a Chrome side panel so an agent can read structured page content and perform browser actions such as clicking, form entry, scrolling, and navigation.

capabilities: Reads structured text from a controlled Chrome tab
Clicks controls and enters form text
Sends keyboard events and scrolls pages
Navigates, reloads, and moves through browser history
Provides a side-panel conversation interface connecting dsh to the browser
